brief: Round 04 refined. Snails drawn plain, move dots in each player's bar, each ending in that player's snail, active dot or icon slightly bolder, coral only on the snails' move, board a little higher, new How to play sheet, and both snails starting on the a-file.

candidates.name: Your move
candidates.concept: Your third move of the cycle is active (bold ring). Both bars end with their snail, inked until the snails move.
traits: Coral only on the snails' next squares

candidates.name: Bishop selected
candidates.concept: Every legal square of the bishop on c4 in bright blue, from the real engine.
traits: Legal squares: b5 a6 d5 e6 f7 d3 e2 f1 b3 a2

candidates.name: Snails' move
candidates.concept: After Black's third move every dot is filled and both snail icons turn coral and bold: the snails are moving.
traits: The only time the indicator turns coral

candidates.name: How to play
candidates.concept: Snail icon and Immortal Snail Chess header, then five rules.

candidates.name: End: SLIMED
candidates.concept: The moment a snail takes your king: the screen drains to grey and SLIMED lands.
traits: Played through the real engine: Black's snail crushes your king on e1 at ply 24

candidates.name: End: slimed result
candidates.concept: After the finale: a result card placed clear of the crushed square, with Rematch first.
traits: Coral snail emblem: lost to a snail

candidates.name: End: checkmate
candidates.concept: A normal checkmate ends calmly: the mated king is boxed with #, and the card has a blue king emblem.
traits: Scholar's mate with snails on the board, played through the engine
No SLIMED: that's only for snails
